title: vendor-src manifest
description: Configuration for vendor-src: vendored dependency sources under a directory such as .repos/.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation.

dir.description: Directory that holds vendored repositories. vendor-src writes .repos when it creates this file; change it if you prefer another folder name. AGENTS.md and ignore tooling follow this setting.

rootAgentsMd.description: Whether vendor-src maintains a managed section in the project-root AGENTS.md. vendor-src writes true when it creates this file; set false to keep the root AGENTS.md untouched (an existing managed section is removed). {dir}/AGENTS.md is always written.

repos.description: Vendored repositories keyed by directory name under dir.

packages.description: npm packages whose source lives in this checkout. The first one's installed version pins version and ref; the rest come from the same repo and share the checkout. Empty for a git-only checkout vendored by URL + ref with no installed package to track.

url.description: Git remote URL used for subtree add/pull.

version.description: Installed package version this checkout is pinned to, or the vendored ref for a git-only checkout.

ref.description: Git ref/tag that was vendored (often package@version).

ignore.description: Globs matched against paths relative to this vendored repo root (posix). There are no built-in defaults — only these patterns (and --ignore on add) are pruned. A pattern ending in /** also matches the directory itself.
